title: 📺 YouTube Gives Parents a Button to Turn Off Shorts!
body: 📺 YouTube Gives Parents a Button to Turn Off Shorts!
YouTube announced new parental controls, most importantly that parents can now set a time limit for browsing Shorts down to zero — turning them off completely for their teenage children.

The platform also added new principles and a guide for creators that directs teens to fun, age-appropriate, higher-quality content, along with an updated sign-up experience that lets parents create a child account.
Simply put, the screen is now in the parents’ hands, not the algorithm’s.
Would you support turning off Shorts for teenagers? Or do you think awareness is the answer?
